author: Flexuz_Strafe
body:
Name: Flexuz_Strafe
The reason I got banned is for 'xray' and 'autoclicker'
The Xray part was true, i did use xray. This was really dumb of me, but i downloaded a hack manager for the sprint thing and sneak. I know there is also the Better Sprinting mod but I need to use that with forge, and forge crashes alot on my computer. I used xray once and the i discovered it was really handy so that was really dumb of me :( But the autoclicker part is not true, i DIDN'T use autoclicker, not any of the forms like 'killaura' 'aimbot' or any of that combat hacks, so i think that is fully unreasonable.

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
This punishment is Valid which means it will not be appealed for a decent amount of time, You must face the consequences of your actions. 

Try appealing in the future, you'll have a better chance.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
